verdict.rationale: Cooley documents a dedicated Cyber/Data/Privacy practice with nearly 100 lawyers globally counseling on privacy, cybersecurity and data protection, plus 400+ privacy/cybersecurity due diligence reviews in the past year for M&A and investment transactions, directly matching the legal-ops privacy-counsel story. missing for 10: explicit mention of specific regimes (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act) and independent/third-party corroboration beyond the firm's own practice page.
